title: Benz Patent Motor Car: The first automobile (1885–1886)
lineage: Inspected the cited passage; retained file is a paraphrased research note, not the original source.

passages.note: Company history describes Benz car completed 1885, patent application 29 January 1886, and July public outing. Bertha Benz and sons used an improved car on a reported 180 km round trip in August 1888.
